lessons.title: Design taste: no AI-generic UI
lessons.hook: Paul's standing rule: editorial/commercial sophistication, large type + whitespace, semantic-only color, no corny copy; Prep.io D8 is the reference implementation

lessons.title: CLAUDE.md is a living guide
lessons.hook: revise the doc when better ideas supersede it; stop reciting stale constraints

lessons.title: Case study magazine playbook
lessons.hook: Paul's structure + anti-AI copy bans for case studies; mag.css is the shared system, Studdy keeps its own

lessons.title: Prep.io V4 rejected; V6 shipped
lessons.hook: dark broadcast UI = garbage; V6 (Oct 2026) is live: light, forest green, big type, motion; case study rebuilt in forest palette

lessons.title: Gentle motion + feathered light
lessons.hook: fast flashes and hard glow bands feel anxious to Paul; feather edges, ~0.5s rise / ~2s settle for ambient light

lessons.title: Sequence over hierarchy
lessons.hook: case studies: one idea per beat at one size, revealed in order; labels/chips/small subtext read as AI; dark bands as breaks

lessons.title: Motion films bar
lessons.hook: demo films need real brand marks/colours, the actual product on screen, aggressive edits; one accent on dark = AI slop

lessons.title: Concept demo films reference
lessons.hook: meliketurgut.com ch.04/07: looping multi-screen prototype clips show the mechanism; skip her personal/chill tone

lessons.title: Bento + big type, no colour-coded cards
lessons.hook: coloured rails/dots/per-feeling palettes read "overly AI"; grey bento tiles, big text, chromatic as one tiny accent

lessons.title: Prototype = watch + try + film
lessons.hook: every prototype ships a self-playing tour, a pure interactive mode, and a fast film that dives inside the app

lessons.title: Hang motion grammar
lessons.hook: rise fast, hang, fall with gravity; one vocabulary; no sliced letters; hold longer on content

lessons.title: Always optimize
lessons.hook: rules before LLMs, cheapest model that passes eval, free infra, cost table with every design

lessons.title: Tool UIs: logos + semantic color
lessons.hook: trackers/dashboards get Mail-style chrome, real logos, color for status only; no giant duplicated hero numbers
